stock_mov_item_ck.name: stock_mov_item_ck
stock_mov_item_ck.value: (item_kind = 'ingredient' AND ingredient_id IS NOT NULL AND product_id IS NULL) OR (item_kind = 'product' AND product_id IS NOT NULL AND ingredient_id IS NULL)

public.v_ingredient_last_price.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (ingredient_id) ingredient_id, supplier_id, date, unit_price_net
  FROM ingredient_prices
  ORDER BY ingredient_id, date DESC, created_at DESC
public.v_ingredient_last_price.name: v_ingredient_last_price

public.v_ingredient_stock.definition:
SELECT ingredient_id, raw_lot_id, location_id, SUM(qty) AS qty
  FROM stock_movements
  WHERE item_kind = 'ingredient'
  GROUP BY ingredient_id, raw_lot_id, location_id
  HAVING SUM(qty) <> 0
public.v_ingredient_stock.name: v_ingredient_stock

public.v_product_stock.definition:
SELECT product_id, finished_lot_id, location_id, SUM(qty) AS qty
  FROM stock_movements
  WHERE item_kind = 'product'
  GROUP BY product_id, finished_lot_id, location_id
  HAVING SUM(qty) <> 0
public.v_product_stock.name: v_product_stock
